name: The Entrance Gate
description: Lin Xueyao climbs the Thousand Steps.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.text:
Hundreds climb the Thousand Steps each spring.
Few pass the gate.
Today, **Lin Xueyao** climbs among them.

name: The Elder's Trial
description: Elder Wen asks three questions with no wrong answer.

lines.speaker: npc.elder_wen
lines.text: A thirsty villager and a wounded fox both reach for your **last waterskin**. What do you do?

choices.text: Give it to the villager. A person's life comes first.
choices.reply: A clear choice, and a hard one. Remember that the fox also had a life to lose.

choices.text: Share it. Half for each, and search for a stream together.
choices.reply: You refuse to abandon either traveller. Then you must accept the effort of finding a third answer.

choices.text: Bind the fox's wound first, then give water to whoever needs it most.
choices.reply: You looked before you gave. Judgement is a kind of mercy too.

lines.speaker: npc.elder_wen
lines.text: A flood threatens a village. A powerful patron offers you a rare manual if you protect only his household. Where do you stand?

choices.text: Protect the village. Power must serve more than its owner.
choices.reply: Then you will face the patron's anger with empty hands. Some debts are worth owing.

choices.text: Ask the patron to open his safe grounds to everyone.
choices.reply: You seek to turn private strength into shelter. Be certain the negotiation does not become an excuse to delay.

choices.text: Refuse his payment and organize the villagers together.
choices.reply: Many hands and no master. It is slower than a sword, and it lasts longer.

lines.speaker: npc.elder_wen
lines.text: If the years became endless, what would make your immortality worth pursuing?

choices.text: The chance to protect those who would otherwise be forgotten.
choices.reply: Then never forget their names. The heavens will not keep them for you.

choices.text: The freedom to understand the world without rushing past it.
choices.reply: Remain curious when mastery makes certainty comfortable. The world is larger than any single method.

choices.text: The bonds I choose to keep, however far the path takes me.
choices.reply: Bonds are the heaviest treasure a cultivator carries. Carry them well.

lines.speaker: npc.bai_lingshuang
lines.text: **Lin Xueyao.** I am Bai Lingshuang. From today, you train under me. Straighten your back, breathe when I say, and do not waste my time.

lines.speaker: npc.bai_lingshuang
lines.text: Then learn to breathe first. Elder Feng keeps the Scripture Pavilion: go to him, and come back to me with your method.

name: First Method
description: Elder Feng sets Lin Xueyao's first cultivation method.

lines.speaker: npc.elder_feng
lines.text: Your first method begins with the breath. Visit the Scripture Pavilion and study Azure Cloud Breathing; the manual you already carry is enough.

lines.speaker: npc.elder_feng
lines.text: Do not drag Qi into the body. Make room for it. Your first method is a rhythm, not a contest.

name: First Sword Art
description: Bai Lingshuang's first lesson: Azure Strike against a training construct.

lines.speaker: npc.bai_lingshuang
lines.text: A clean strike begins in the breath. Use Azure Strike three times against a training construct; its bark will show you where you hesitate.

lines.speaker: npc.bai_lingshuang
lines.text: Better. You hesitated on the second strike, and the construct heard it. Again tomorrow, at dawn.
